title: WP-100 Environment: the agent builder's environment section (C20.18)

screenshots.where: Agent builder > the agent's card > Environment (agent harness on); none taken here (no stack)

cases.title: Setup steps
steps: Open an agent in the builder with the agent harness on
Open Environment, choose Setup steps, enter commands and settings, save
expected: The agent saves; reopening shows the same commands and settings
Saved as the agent's environment (level agent)

cases.title: From devcontainer.json
steps: Choose From devcontainer.json and paste a file with image, containerEnv and postCreateCommand
expected: The note says image is not used (the engine's image is the base)

cases.title: A variable that looks secret
expected: The line is named as looking like a secret, with 'connect it as an account instead'
Save sends no environment until it is fixed
